content: Transitioning from brand positioning to the fundamental material grades utilized by these competitors, the sector is witnessing a pronounced shift driven by macroeconomic factors, decarbonization targets, and the relentless pursuit of enhanced component longevity. While retrospective data detailing specific material grade usage between 2020 and 2023 is largely overshadowed by forward-looking industry projections, current market trajectories offer profound insights into the metallurgical strategies adopted by leading manufacturers. A dominant trend in the current manufacturing landscape is the strategic pivot towards low-carbon steel variants. This material category has achieved significant market prominence, currently holding a dominant 58.4 percent market share within relevant sectors [22] . The preference for low-carbon steel, particularly in flat steel products, aligns with the broader industry mandate to reduce the carbon footprint of mining operations without compromising the structural integrity of the wear parts [22] . For Alpha Industries SA, synthesizing these competitive and material intelligence insights is vital for strategic planning. The market is clearly bifurcated between global giants like Metso, who leverage substantial capital investments and advanced engineering capabilities, and specialized providers seeking regional footholds. Imported Mining Wear Parts Ratio The supply chain dynamics of mining wear parts within South Africa represent a critical area of strategic focus, characterized by a complex interplay between domestic manufacturing capabilities and a historical reliance on foreign imports. The global wear parts industry has experienced considerable growth, with forecasts suggesting a market value reaching 3.77 billion by 2033 at a compound annual growth rate of 6.3 percent [31] . The strategic direction of the industry is effectively encapsulated by the Mining Indaba 2026 theme, "Stronger Together: Progress Through Partnerships," which reflects a growing emphasis on collaborative alliances to drive progress, optimize supply chains, and enhance overall operational resilience through collective strategies [32] . This partnership-driven approach is critical for domestic manufacturers aiming to capture an even larger share of the wear parts market and push the local production ratio beyond the 48.0 percent achieved in 2023.
